explanation: This lemma is the unfolding equation for the successor case of the library's own `Rew.fixitr` (an iterated composition of `Rew.fix`). `Rew.fixitr`, `Rew.fix` and `Rew.comp` are defined in the library (the Foundation port), not in Mathlib, and the proof only unfolds that definition with `simp [fixitr]`. All of the mathematical content is in the library's own definitions, so no Mathlib declaration can state this result. I did not search Mathlib, because none of these constants occur there.
